title: An epithalamian charm to ensure the birth of a boy

verses.t: Asvattha on the Sami-tree. There a male birth is certified. There is the finding of a son: this bring we to the women-folk.
The father sows the genial seed, the woman tends and fosters it. This is the finding of a son: thus hath Prajāpati declared.
Prajāpati, Anumati, Sinivāli have ordered it. Elsewhere may he effect the birth of maids, but here prepare a boy.
